title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-2026-03-04
content:
Weekly sync: serving-runtime / infra / console — agenda (Wed 2026-03-04)

Attendees (expected): Samira, Ravi, Maya, Lucas, Ivy, + optional: Jin, Priya 
Timebox: 45m
Purpose: surface blockers for next-week rollouts, ops incidents, console UX items that affect alerting/tracing, and confirm action owners. Keep it tactical; save deep design for follow-ups.

Agenda:
1) Quick rundowns (5m) — 30s each: major wins/risks from each subteam (serving runtime, infra, console)
   - Running note: Ravi (infra) — autoscale budge test passed on m-2 cluster, but spike handling still has ~400ms p99 spike (see JIRA RW-1501)
   - Maya (console) — cost dashboard landed in staging; need filter UX for model variants
   - Lucas (runtime) — prefix caching prototype shows 12% token reduction on our internal perfbench; behavior edge cases with cache invalidation when model pinned.

2) Incident postmortem follow-ups (10m) — RW-1428 (KV cache eviction event)
   - Summary: interleaved cache invalidation + rollout caused cache thrash, increased latency; mitigation was rollback to previous model variant.
   - Action items from postmortem (see below).

3) Rollout plan check (10m) — canary for quantized-2 model on dedicated pools
   - Current plan: 5% canary -> 25% -> 50% -> full over 72h with auto-rollback on error rate > 0.5% or latency p99 > baseline +200ms.
   - Risk: quantized-2 has different memory working set; need infra to validate instance sizing for dedicated pools (Ravi).
   - Decision needed: enable KV prewarming for canary? Pros: reduces first-request latency. Cons: extra memory + longer init.

4) Console/observability gaps (10m)
   - Missing: route-level breakdown for cached vs non-cached tokens (Maya to add metric spec).
   - Tracing: need a dropdown to correlate trace id -> vm instance id in console (Lucas to propose API change).

5) Open sync / blockers (5m)
   - Any PRs needing reviews (callouts)
   - Any infra quota requests / capacity reservations this week

Notes / discussion highlights (live notes):
- Ravi: autoscale policy needs an adjustment to prefer cold-start capacity in region-eu rather than bursting remote pools — follow-up ticket.
- Lucas: cache invalidation root cause seems to be concurrent delta rollout + a miss in model version compatibility check. We should add stronger preflight gating.
- Maya: console filter for variant -> UX stub ready. Wants sample API for cached-token breakdown so frontend can show cost impact per route.
- Samira: remind teams to attach perfbench results to rollout tickets (pattern we've missed).

Action items (tracked) — short, owner, due date, status (TODO/IN_PROGRESS/DONE)
1) Draft autoscale tweak proposal to prefer local cold-start capacity (Ravi) — due 2026-03-06 — TODO — linked: JIRA:RW-1501
2) Add metric spec for cached vs non-cached token counts and emit in telemetry pipeline (Maya + Lucas) — due 2026-03-09 — IN_PROGRESS — linked: GHPR #421
3) Add preflight gating check to rollout pipeline to prevent model-variant incompatibility (Lucas) — due 2026-03-08 — TODO — linked: JIRA:RW-1520
4) KV cache eviction mitigation: implement soft-evict threshold and alerting rule (Samira + Ravi) — due 2026-03-10 — TODO — postmortem action from RW-1428
5) Console: add trace -> vm instance mapping endpoint + frontend stub (Maya) — due 2026-03-11 — TODO
6) Perfbench attachments: update rollout ticket template to require perfbench artifacts and short summary (Samira) — due 2026-03-05 — IN_PROGRESS

Parking lot / follow-ups (not for this sync):
- Deep-dive session: prefix/KV caching strategies across multi-tenant workloads (1.5h) — schedule next week; Lucas to prep slides.
- Cost-optimization spike: investigate per-route quantization suggestions in Redwood Optimize integration — Maya to reach out to product.

Prep for next sync (what to bring):
- Infra: updated autoscale proposal (Ravi)
- Runtime: short demo/notes on cache invalidation fix and preflight gating (Lucas)
- Console: draft metric spec + mockups for cached-token filter (Maya)

Quick links (for meeting):
- Postmortem RW-1428: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/RW-1428
- Autoscale ticket RW-1501: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-1501
- GH PR (metric emit): https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/421
- Slack thread (incident): https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02SERVING/p1657634000-0

Notes-to-self (Samira):
- Follow up with SRE on alert thresholds before deploying soft-evict threshold change.
- Remind Product to include acceptance criteria for console metrics in rollout tickets.
- Keep a short one-pager on canary rollback thresholds we can share with stakeholder PMs.

-- end of doc --
